author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the 27th of March of 2015, I first encounter now the word "tetragram." It is apparently any square-shaped symbol of a complex writing system in the Sinosphere. A sinogram, or sinograph, is a tetragram. It is my first time of learning that term. "Tetra" means four. Japanese Kana are tetragrams, as well as Korean Hangeul, because they are square-shaped, too.

jyutping: hai2 2015 nin4 3 jyut6 27 hou6，ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 jyu6 dou3「sei3 gok3 jing4」ni1 go3 zi6。keoi5 baai2 ming4 hai6 zung1 gwok3 hyun1 jat1 go3 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 se2 zok3 hai6 tung2 ge3 jam6 ho4 fong1 jing4 fu4 hou2。zung1 man2 zi6 mou5，hai6 jat1 go3 sei3 zi6 mou5。ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 hok6 ni1 go3 ci4 jyu5。「Tetra」ge3 ji3 si1 hai6 sei3 go3。jat6 bun2 gaa2 ming4 hai6 sei3 zi6 jing4，tung4 maai4 hon4 man2 hon3 zi6，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 hai6 fong1 jing4。
text: 喺2015年3月27號，我第一次遇到「四角形」呢個字。佢擺明係中國圈一個複雜嘅寫作系統嘅任何方形符號。中文字母，係一個四字母。呢個係我第一次學呢個詞語。「Tetra」嘅意思係四個。日本假名係四字形，同埋韓文漢字，因為佢哋都係方形。
